title: PsychEthicsBench: Evaluating Large Language Models Against Australian Mental Health Ethics

bias_targets.methodology: Quantifying implicit U.S.-centric assumptions by measuring the frequency of U.S.-specific references (e.g., American institutions, hotlines) via string matching, and using an LLM-as-a-judge to detect 'Jurisdictional' ethical rule violations where models inappropriately apply foreign norms in an Australian mental health context.

Evaluating open-ended model responses using an LLM-as-a-judge against a 'Disrespect' ethical rubric category to detect prejudice, stigma, stereotyping, or dismissiveness toward individuals or groups based on mental health status, culture, or identity.
